parakeet: If the apostles' supposed martyrdoms were so central to the Christian message, why didn't Paul mention them? Why didn't Acts record them? Why didn't early church letters make them a focal point? The simplest explanation, they either hadn't happened yet, or they weren't known, or they never happened at all. Instead, we get silence, and that silence speaks volumes.
